acceptanceCriteria: User can register with email and password
Password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and number
User receives confirmation email after registration
User can login with valid credentials
User cannot login with invalid credentials

testResults.title: User login with valid credentials
testResults.description: Validate that a user can login with valid credentials
testResults.expectedResult: User is logged in and redirected to the dashboard
testResults.evidence:
✅ All steps executed successfully
User is logged in and redirected to the dashboard

testResults.title: User login with invalid credentials
testResults.description: Validate that a user cannot login with invalid credentials
testResults.expectedResult: User remains on the login page and is not logged in
testResults.evidence:
✅ All steps executed successfully
User remains on the login page and is not logged in

testResults.title: User registration with valid credentials
testResults.description: Validate that a user can register with a valid email and password
testResults.expectedResult: User is created and can be retrieved using the provided email
testResults.evidence:
✅ All steps executed successfully
User is created and can be retrieved using the provided email

testResults.title: Password complexity validation
testResults.description: Validate that the password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and number
testResults.expectedResult: Server returns an error indicating that the password is not complex enough
testResults.evidence:
✅ All steps executed successfully
Server returns an error indicating that the password is not complex enough

testResults.title: User receives confirmation email

testResults.evidence:
✅ All steps executed successfully
